name: Simran Sainand Revankar
headline:
A mind for science.
A life beyond one subject.
intro: I explore functional materials, thin films and devices—and use writing to follow the questions that continue beyond the laboratory.
about: My work moves between chemistry, materials and functional devices, from perovskite nanocomposites to ferroelectric thin films. Alongside research, I love writing and exploring interests beyond my discipline. This is a home for both.
contact: Have a research, writing or collaborative idea? I would be glad to hear from you.

services.title: Research communication
services.text: Clear explanations, educational material and science writing shaped around chemistry and materials research.

services.title: Data and visualization
services.text: Thoughtful organization and presentation of experimental data using Python, OriginPro, ImageJ and related tools.

services.title: Writing and editing
services.text: Support with clarity, structure and flow for articles, presentations and student publications.
